header: L14 · The maintainer on duty · sonnet
verdict: Round 9 resolution R9-27 holds (RJ-334 record-unreadable is in 4.4 and cited by 03). R9-26 holds in 04 4.1 but 05 'Safe to paste' still states the old broad claim, so the two pages contradict.

findings.defect: 04 4.1 now limits the paste claim to argv, status, step and versions and says a token in a remote URL or sbx body is not removed, but 05 'Safe to paste' still says the details of an error hold no secret value because romeu never handles one (I25), so both can be pasted into an issue.
findings.scenario: A stranger reads the security page (the one the guide and a SECURITY-minded maintainer cite), pastes full error details including the 4 KiB of git stderr with a tokenised remote URL, and the token lands in a public issue; the implementer of the guide text has two contradicting sources.
findings.change: Reword 05 'Safe to paste' to the 4.1 scope: argv, status, step and versions are safe; stderr passes the recorder's replacement of home, user, host and root paths but not tokens, so the reader looks it over; or replace the paragraph with a link to 4.1 and have a test hold the link.

out_of_scope: The G5 pull_request_target job, ruleset reading, ADR 0010 and the D2/D3 decisions were skimmed only for contributor-loop impact; no L14 defect found there.
confidence: Medium: read by grep and the delta text, not run.
